text.div: Patient presents with 3-day history of severe sore throat, fever, fatigue, and bilateral cervical lymphadenopathy. Reports mild headache and nasal congestion. No significant cough.
Temperature: 38.6°C. Throat: markedly erythematous with tonsillar exudate bilaterally. Lymph nodes: bilateral cervical lymphadenopathy palpable. Rapid strep antigen test: POSITIVE.
Streptococcal pharyngitis (Group A Streptococcus). Acute bacterial tonsillitis.

1. Prescribe Amoxicillin 500 mg TID × 10 days. 2. Rest and adequate hydration. 3. Ibuprofen 400 mg PRN or Paracetamol 500 mg PRN for fever and pain. 4. Return if symptoms worsen or fail to improve within 48–72 hours.
